title: A town in the census can be a village on paper
sources: Census of India 2011, Provisional Population Totals, Urban Agglomerations and Cities

quiz.q: Which is NOT a criterion for a census town?
quiz.why: Right. Census towns have no urban local body; that is what separates them from statutory towns.
